title: Small, Base Metal Tins Belong in Dollar Store
text:
Small, Base Metal Tins Belong in Dollar Store. These MIND READER METAL CANISTERS (3 Piece, Galvanized Metal, Silver) are vastly overpriced (about $21 on Amazon). They are lightweight, base metal tins with loose-fitting lids. (A rubber gasket helps seal the lids, but you can’t even lift an empty tin by the lid handle.)

The advertised 6-cup capacity is too little to hold much of anything, unless you want the tins for an employee break room to hold sugar packets, individually-wrapped tea bags, and K-cups or instant coffee packets. The tins aren’t good for holding other things (e.g., home-baked cookies, hard candies), because of the labels for “Coffee”, “Sugar”, and “Tea”. Whatever you put in these, it will need frequent replenishment because of the tins’ small size.

Overall, the tins look and feel cheap. The silver finish has an odd, tacky feel, even when the tins are brand new. The gold-toned metal labels are hard to read and marginally attractive—yet they are probably the reason for the inflated price. This set is something that I would expect to find in a Dollar Store.

There are no included “use and care” instructions, so I’m guessing that they are “wipe clean” only. Dishwasher detergent will probably leave pits in the surface.
